verdict.rationale: The evidence pack details Gusto Embedded Payroll's APIs for payroll runs, off-cycle payrolls, contractor payments, and time-off (PTO) requests, but contains no documentation of hourly time-entry or overtime calculation features that flow into a payroll run. The only related mention is a vague statement that Gusto 'works with' third-party time tracking apps, which does not establish a native hourly/overtime-to-payroll pipeline.
